description.html: This 100x50x50 cm terrarium (250 L) stands out with a polystyrene 3D background that we shape and paint by hand. The background evokes a rocky or forest setting and gives animals functional surfaces for moving vertically.

The horizontal layout with 100 cm of length gives a floor area where a basking zone, a cool zone and a hiding area are easy to arrange. This layout is key for reptiles because it lets them choose the temperature they are exposed to. Ventilation is provided by mesh openings that allow airflow and humidity control inside the terrarium.

Because we build every terrarium by hand, we adapt it to your requirements, from dimensions and film to the background and ventilation system. Call or write to us for free advice and a quote. We ship to every city in Serbia.
